title: Walk the King to the Corner
setup: Black's king sits on a7 beside its bishop on d8, and your queen and both rooks are close enough to reach it.
hint: Every move should be a check. Let the queen herd the king back toward a7, and let a rook give the last one.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd7+}} and {{Qc6+}} do not try to mate. Each check takes squares away, until the king is back on a7 with nothing left and {{Ra8#}} arrives. A hunt is a sequence of checks that each remove one option.
